create_builder_configs: create builder configs for 10 visual domain decathlon image classification datasets
build_visual_domain_decathlon_dataset: build a VisualDomainDecathlon dataset builder with train, validation, and test splits
create_dataset_info: create dataset info with image, label, and name features for a specified number of classes

get_filename_to_label_map: get a mapping from image filenames to label indices from decathlon annotation JSON files
